veranderings.rede: 'Gelyk behandel' is the natural Afrikaans idiom for equal treatment, and it keeps this 'behandel' apart from the medical 'behandel' later in the text.

vlae.teks: Daardie reël het gesê 'n openbare skool mag nie 'n kind met MIV wegwys nie. In Suid-Afrika mag geen openbare skool 'n kind wegwys omdat die kind MIV het nie.
vlae.rede: The same rule is stated twice in two consecutive sentences, which reads as repetitive; merging them would touch protected wording, so it is left to the writer to decide whether both are needed.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry writes VIGS in capitals, but the lesson and the decided glossary headword write 'vigs' in lower case, as the AWS does; nothing needs to change in the lesson, but the entry's casing may be worth bringing into line.
